第二天上午九点半。

衡复片区的路不宽。

车开进去以后，速度自然慢了下来。

两侧梧桐树枝压得低，阳光碎在车窗上。

老洋房藏在树影后，铁艺门刷过漆，门柱上有岁月留下的灰痕。

陈怀民已经等在门口。

他今天没穿夹克，换了件深色针织衫，手里拿着一串钥匙。

顾城下车后看了一圈。

“这地方可以啊。”

他压低声音，“不像开店，像藏赃款。”

苏晚棠看了他一眼。

“顾少，您这句话放在招商材料里，会很有创意。”

顾城乐了。

“苏秘书现在真是越来越会聊天了。”

林川没有接话。

他站在铁门外，看着院子里那棵老梧桐。

树根压着青砖，枝干伸到二楼窗前。

小院不大，但安静。

外面的车声传进来，已经淡了很多。

陈怀民走过来。

“房主姓许。老上海人，家里以前做出版。现在老两口住徐汇另一套房子，这里空了两年。”

顾城问：“缺钱吗？”

“不缺。”

陈怀民把钥匙插进锁孔，“所以难谈。”

门开了。

院子里有一条青石小路，通向两层小楼。

外立面是青砖，窗框还是老木头，二楼有彩色玻璃窗。

门厅不大，进去就是旧木楼梯，踩上去会有轻响。

苏晚棠拿出本子，开始记。

“入口动线不错。院子可以做迎客区，但不能摆太满。”

她抬头看了眼楼梯。

“楼梯保留的话，承重和防滑要重新检测。”

顾城摸着扶手。

“这楼梯拆了重做？”

林川看他。

“不拆。”

顾城马上改口。

“我也觉得不拆。老东西嘛，拆了就没味了。”

陈怀民笑了一声。

“你这见风使舵，比改装车换胎还快。”

几人往里走。

一楼原本是会客厅和餐厅，墙面有些发黄，但层高足。

后面有小厨房，通向侧门。

二楼有四个房间，其中两个带露台，窗外能看见梧桐树冠。

苏晚棠一路看，一路记。

“厨房太小。如果只做茶点和简餐够用，要做正式宴请，需要外部中央厨房配合。”

“停车是问题。门口不能乱停，最多两辆。会员车要提前登记，司机动线要单独做。”

“安保不能太显眼。这里如果站两个黑西装，气质就毁了。”

顾城点头。

“对，不能弄得像夜总会门口查房。”

苏晚棠合上本子。

“顾少，您今天的表达很刑。”

顾城：“……”

他发现自己在苏晚棠面前，越来越像素材库。

二楼尽头有一间书房。

彩色玻璃窗把光隔成几块，落在旧地板上。

墙边还留着一排空书架，木头发暗，但没有霉味。

林川推开窗。

院子里那棵梧桐的枝叶就在眼前。

风进来，屋里旧木味淡了些。

顾城站到他旁边。

“这间给你？”

林川看着窗外。

“主茶室。”

顾城一愣。

“你自己的房间不要？”

“我又不是来这里躲清闲的。”

林川说，“这里的每一间房，都要有用途。”

顾城想了想，点头。

“行，老板不配有私人空间。”

It was half past nine the next morning.

The roads in Hengfu area are not wide.

After the car drove in, the speed naturally slowed down.

The sycamore branches on both sides were pressed low, and the sun shone on the car windows.

The old bungalow is hidden behind the shadow of the trees. The wrought iron door has been painted and there are gray marks left by the years on the doorpost.

Chen Huaimin was already waiting at the door.

He was not wearing a jacket today, had changed into a dark knitted sweater, and was holding a bunch of keys in his hand.

Gu Cheng got out of the car and looked around.

"This place is okay."

He lowered his voice, "It's not like opening a store, it's like hiding stolen money."

Su Wantang glanced at him.

"Young Master Gu, if you put this sentence in investment materials, it would be very creative."

Gu Cheng was happy.

"Secretary Su is really getting better at chatting now."

Lin Chuan didn't answer.

He stood outside the iron gate and looked at the old sycamore tree in the yard.

The roots of the tree press against the blue bricks, and the branches stretch to the second floor window.

The courtyard is not big, but quiet.

The sound of cars outside came in, and it had faded a lot.

Chen Huaimin came over.

"The landlord's surname is Xu. He is an old Shanghainese. His family used to be a publisher. Now the old couple live in another house in Xuhui. This place has been empty for two years."

Gu Cheng asked: "Are you short of money?"

"No shortage."

Chen Huaimin inserted the key into the keyhole, "So it's difficult to talk."

The door opened.

There is a bluestone path in the yard leading to the two-story building.

The exterior facade is made of blue bricks, the window frames are still old wood, and there are stained glass windows on the second floor.

The foyer is not big, and there is an old wooden staircase when you walk in. There will be a light sound when you step on it.

Su Wantang took out his notebook and began to write down.

"The entrance circulation is good. The courtyard can be used as a welcoming area, but it cannot be too full."

She glanced up at the stairs.

"If the stairs are to be retained, the load-bearing and anti-slip properties must be re-tested."

Gu Cheng touched the armrest.

"Have the stairs been torn down and redone?"

Lin Chuan looked at him.

"Don't tear it down."

Gu Cheng immediately changed his tune.

"I don't think it should be dismantled either. It's an old thing. It will lose its flavor if it is dismantled."

Chen Huaimin laughed.

"You are able to adapt to the wind and change tires faster than a modified car."

Several people walked inside.

The first floor was originally the living room and dining room. The walls are a little yellow, but the floor is high enough.

There is a small kitchen in the back, which leads to a side door.

There are four rooms on the second floor, two of which have terraces, and the sycamore canopy can be seen outside the window.

Su Wantang watched and memorized all the way.

"The kitchen is too small. If it is only enough for tea and simple meals, but for formal banquets, an external central kitchen is needed."

"Parking is a problem. No random parking is allowed at the door, no more than two. Member cars must be registered in advance, and drivers must move independently."

"The security cannot be too conspicuous. If there are two people in black suits standing here, the temperament will be ruined."

Gu Cheng nodded.

"Yes, it can't be like a ward check at the entrance of a nightclub."

Su Wantang closed the notebook.

"Young Master Gu, your expression today is very harsh."

Gu Cheng: "..."

He found that in front of Su Wantang, he looked more and more like a material library.

There is a study room at the end of the second floor.

Stained glass windows divide the light into sections, falling onto the old floor.

There is still a row of empty bookshelves next to the wall. The wood is dark, but there is no musty smell.

Lin Chuan opened the window.

The branches and leaves of the sycamore tree in the yard are right in front of me.

The wind came in, and the smell of old wood in the house became lighter.

Gu Cheng stood next to him.

"Is this room for you?"

Lin Chuan looked out the window.

"Main Tea Room."

Gu Cheng was stunned.

"You don't want your own room?"

"I'm not here to hide and relax."

Lin Chuan said, "Every room here must have a purpose."

Gu Cheng thought for a while and nodded.

"Okay, the boss doesn't have a private space."
